name: tac-express-skillpack
description: Consolidated single-system Claude Code skillpack for TAC Express. Combines the v2.0 consolidated layout with GBrain-pattern enforcement (RESOLVER + conventions + evals + skillify). Canonical location: .claude/skills/.

borrowed: skillify (10-item conformance audit, adapted from GBrain's 11-item)

skills.name: tac-express-onboarding
skills.mandatory: every session
skills.summary: 60-second orientation — monorepo, design system, Fourteen Laws, package boundaries, routing table to specialists

skills.name: tac-karpathy-discipline
skills.mandatory: every non-trivial task
skills.summary: Think-Before-Coding → Simplicity-First → Surgical-Changes → Goal-Driven-Execution

skills.name: tac-fourteen-laws
skills.mandatory: when uncertain whether something is allowed
skills.summary: The Fourteen Laws + forbidden packages + architecture flow + violation patterns + remediation snippets

skills.name: tac-brainstorming
skills.mandatory: before any new feature/component/architectural change
skills.summary: Design approval — surfaces trade-offs, confirms architecture fit, produces written spec before code

skills.name: tac-tdd
skills.mandatory: all non-trivial implementation
skills.summary: RED → GREEN → REFACTOR cycle with Vitest. Failing test first, always.

skills.name: tac-debug
skills.mandatory: any bug / test failure / unexpected behaviour
skills.summary: Root cause before fix. No guessing. Never bypass safety checks.

skills.name: tac-code-review
skills.mandatory: pre-merge, post-feature, after bug fix
skills.summary: Law compliance + Violet Grid adherence + architecture correctness + code quality

skills.name: tac-skillify
skills.mandatory: when a workflow recurs or after fixing the same bug twice
skills.summary: Meta skill — turn any recurring fix or repeated workflow into a properly-skilled, tested, resolvable unit

skills.name: tac-shadcn
skills.mandatory: whenever a UI primitive is needed, added, or modified
skills.summary: shadcn foundation (preset b5Fxrc2eNU). Single sourcing law — every primitive enters via shadcn CLI / @tac registry / MCP into packages/ui, then re-themed to Violet Grid. Nothing hand-rolled, no other UI library.

skills.name: tac-ui-authoring
skills.mandatory: writing or modifying any UI component
skills.summary: Violet Grid component pattern: CVA + Radix/shadcn primitives + semantic tokens + data-slot

skills.name: tac-design-tokens
skills.mandatory: premium UI surfaces (hero, KPI, dashboard, marketing)
skills.summary: Full Violet Grid v6 token reference — colors, type scale, motion vocabulary, FUI utilities, gradients

skills.name: tac-premium-patterns
skills.mandatory: build a hero / KPI / dashboard / landing / drawer / empty state
skills.summary: 15 paste-ready compositions scoring 9-10/10 on tac-ui-rubric — fully tokenized, motion + 4-state coverage

skills.name: tac-micro-interactions
skills.mandatory: hover / focus / press / state-change / sequencing animations
skills.summary: Motion vocabulary catalog — 15 recipes mapped to instant/smooth/expressive tokens, reduced-motion safe

skills.name: tac-ui-rubric
skills.mandatory: score a UI surface / pre-merge UI gate
skills.summary: 10-criterion measurable score (0-100) with verdict ladder PREMIUM/STRONG/REJECT and per-criterion file:line evidence

skills.name: tac-uipro-bridge
skills.mandatory: before any ui-ux-pro-max (uipro) invocation
skills.summary: Filters uipro's 67 styles / 96 palettes / 57 fonts through Violet Grid before surfacing — never let breadth break identity

skills.name: tac-accessibility
skills.mandatory: a11y review / keyboard / screen-reader / focus
skills.summary: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance with Violet Grid constraints — Radix primitive wiring + custom checks

skills.name: tac-data-layer
skills.mandatory: writing services, DB queries, hooks, any data-fetching logic
skills.summary: UI → packages/services → packages/database → Supabase. Architecture flow enforced.

skills.name: tac-supabase-schema
skills.mandatory: schema / RLS / migrations / RPC / triggers
skills.summary: RLS-by-role enforcement + SECURITY DEFINER usage + type regeneration patterns

skills.name: tac-domain-logistics
skills.mandatory: shipments / manifests / AWBs / hubs / rate cards / scanning / exceptions
skills.summary: Real domain model, status lifecycles, branded types, financial model, RPC names, event-derivation rules

skills.name: tac-api-surface
skills.mandatory: route handlers / server actions / public API / webhooks / edge functions
skills.summary: Boundary validation + rate-limit (Upstash) + signing + public-vs-authenticated split

skills.name: tac-auth
skills.mandatory: auth / session / middleware / RBAC
skills.summary: Cookie-based SSR auth with @supabase/ssr

skills.name: tac-forms
skills.mandatory: any form
skills.summary: react-hook-form + zod resolver + server actions + Violet Grid field components

skills.name: ui-ux-pro-max
skills.mandatory: never invoke directly — always via tac-uipro-bridge
skills.summary: Third-party breadth tool (67 styles / 96 palettes / 57 fonts). Most output is forbidden by Violet Grid; the bridge filters.

conventions.name: friction-protocol
conventions.applies_to: any request to violate a law

evals.name: routing
evals.description: Intent -> skill dispatch tests; one JSONL line per real user phrase.

checks: Every skill has valid frontmatter (name + description).
Every skill is reachable from RESOLVER.md.
No two skills share > 80% of trigger phrases (MECE).
Conventions cited by skills exist on disk.
routing.jsonl entries refer to existing skills.

deprecated.reason: GSD framework — never wired into Claude Code hooks (not referenced from .claude/settings.local.json)
Merged into AGENTS.md § 4 The Fourteen Laws + § 7 Git Standards
